These fixtures derive from the local application's actual revision-174 APIs on 2026-10-21.

- `bootstrap-compact.json` is the actual `/api/v1/bootstrap` response, whose compact catalog deliberately omits `sources`.
- `ev-research-v1.1-oh.json` preserves actual v1.1 Ohio and Alaska call values and response fields from `.local/atlas-depth/ev-model-final.json`. It reduces the race list, duplicate source-reference arrays, and bulky historical validation case list for a small rendering fixture. It is a response-shape regression fixture, not a reproducible research package.

The SSR regression renders the real Forecasts component with the source-omitting bootstrap, an EV-informed call, a withheld ranked-choice call, and a state without a selected contest. It catches runtime assumptions that mathematical helper tests and stale TypeScript declarations cannot detect.

`ev-research-expanded-nc.json` is derived from the actual r242 expanded NC model response in `.local/atlas-depth/ev-expanded-ui.json` on 2026-10-21. It retains all 14 genuine historical EV audit rows, actual outcome/forecast/error values, two independent Senate contests (2020/2022), low-confidence publication state, exact county inputs, and evaluated sensitivity points. Repeated source-reference arrays are shortened and only 16 of 1,238 excluded-case records are retained. It is a compact contract/rendering fixture, not a complete reproducibility package. The untrained fixed-coefficient audit is kept distinct from zero fitted-EV held-out cases and absent calibrated probabilities.

`ev-stage-r253-nc.json` and `ev-stage-r253-oh.json` derive from actual `/api/v2/early-vote/history` service proofs at revision 253 on 2026-10-21. NC has four eligible exact-stage comparisons; OH's selected cast-ballot definition has no compatible historical exact-stage record and retains explicit gaps. Actual trajectory values, source dates, native mode measures, administrative final-participation references and conditional 90/100/110% assumptions are retained. Repeated source-reference arrays are shortened. The stage component tests use the earlier call fixtures only for state/metric configuration; they do not claim those older model runs used r253 evidence.

`ev-stage-r253-nc-opening.json` is the actual NC early-in-person, days-since-opening stage response at r253. It includes original pre-opening reports down to Day −40 and the current Day 6 report. The chart regression verifies the default nonnegative display window and optional pre-opening display without altering source/export data.

`ev-research-r261-nc.json` and `ev-stage-r261-nc.json` preserve the final actual r261 NC contracts: 37 EV audit rows across seven Senate contests, zero trained-EV holdouts, a conditional turnout analogue whose span excludes model error, and seven turnout-audit rows from two independent state-election outcomes. The full audit's actual ~19.9% turnout MAPE remains visible. Calls are limited to NC/OH/AK; repeated provenance and exclusion lists are shortened. This is a rendering fixture, not a complete research package.
